name: Cursor
removalRules: Moppo offers verified older CLI versions for removal to Trash. It keeps the active and rollback versions, CLI conversations, and workspace state. Verified Electron caches and linked Git worktrees use the existing review controls.
note: Both native CLI launchers link to the active version. Moppo keeps builds from the active release date and the latest earlier release date for rollback. Cursor advises deleting chats through History. Moppo keeps CLI sessions because they have no cloud backup.
